question: For the given tire size, as per specification as 205/55R16, what is the width of the tire?
solution:
The correct answer is __205 mm__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given tire size is 205/55R16.
 
• 205 mm__ is the width of the tire in millimeters.
 
• The __55__ in the tire size represents the aspect ratio, which is the height of the tire's sidewall as a percentage of the width.
 
• The __R__ stands for radial construction, indicating the type of tire.
 
• The __16__ is the diameter of the wheel rim in inches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The tire size specification provides crucial information about tire dimensions and type.
 
• It is important to select the correct tire size for optimal vehicle performance and safety.
 
• Incorrect tire size can affect handling, fuel efficiency, and the overall lifespan of the tires.
